definition: Knowledge compilation is a family of approaches for addressing the intractability of a number of artificial intelligence problems.
details: A propositional model is compiled in an off-line phase in order to support some queries in polynomial time. Many ways of compiling a propositional model exist. Different compiled representations have different properties. The three main properties are: The compactness of the representation The queries that are supported in polynomial time The transformations of the representations that can be performed in polynomial time

explainer.lead: Knowledge compilation is a family of approaches for addressing the intractability of a number of AI problems. It matters because it moves expensive reasoning into an offline phase so queries become cheap.

tiers.eli5: It is like doing the hard homework once in advance so later questions can be answered quickly.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers compile a propositional model offline so that certain queries can then be answered in polynomial time. The trade-off is that compiled representations differ in compactness and in which queries and transformations stay polynomial.
tiers.paperLevel: A propositional model is compiled in an off-line phase to support some queries in polynomial time; the three main properties are compactness of the representation, queries supported in polynomial time, and transformations performable in polynomial time.

explainer.example: A propositional model is compiled offline, after which selected queries on the compiled representation run in polynomial time.
